lastCompletedStory.title: Bound verb/config co-occurrence cue to a single field

nextStoryContext: SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES config cue in src/release/pr-body.ts now uses a newline-bounded gap ([^\n]*?) for both verb/config order-alternatives, so the co-occurrence check is scoped to one haystack field (description, notes, or a single story title). The other two alternatives (bare project.toml, config(uration) file phrase) are untouched. renderSetupChecklist still joins fields with '\n' into one haystack; no per-field iteration or normalization was added.
